title.narrative: Supporting vulnerable conflict-affected households through a comprehensive CCCM response in Areeshesh and Serekaniye camps and informal settlements across Al-Hasakeh, Ar-Raqqa and Deir-ez Zor

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThe proposed intervention aims to enhance the living conditions of vulnerable conflict affected households in Al-Hasakeh, Raqqa and Deir-ez Zor governorates, through the provision of comprehensive CCCM services in camp location, informal settlements/collective centers, and providing critical food assistance across out-of-camp locations in Al-Hasakeh governorate. ltbrgtActed will provide a comprehensive package of CCCM support to vulnerable IDPs in Areesheh and Sereknaiye camps, and at least 80 informal settlements/ collective centers across NES, estimating to benefit 46,345 individuals. CCCM activities include coordination and management, capacity building, monitoring and data management, registration and access, communication and feedback, protection and referrals, community engagement initiatives, safety and site improvements, emergency preparedness, depending on the modality selected per each camp/site. Acted will contract with the REACH initiative as a service provider to support the CCCM Cluster and other relevant stakeholders in NES through supporting information management efforts and the provision of technical assistance, strengthening the capacities of the cluster to inform strategic and programmatic decision-making related to CCCM in NES. ltbrgtIn addition, Acted will support the emergency needs of vulnerable populations in out of camp settings through the distribution of cash for food. Acted plans to reach 7,950 individuals (1,325 households) in neighborhoods across Hasakeh city in Al-Hasakeh sub-district and governorate. ltbrgtActed will address humanitarian aid gaps and ensure the continuity of critical humanitarian services impacted by the prematurely terminated USAID grants. Acted’s implementation will align with the CCCM and FSL Cluster recommendations and will rely on Acted’s previous location selection and household targeting under the impacted USAID funding. ltbrgtlt/pgt
